Commentary.Commentary: So that's it from here. India won comfortably and will be looking forward to their next game against Sarfraz Ahmed's Pakistan on Sunday in Dubai at 1530 local (1130 GMT). There's another game on that day in Abu Dhabi, at the same time, between Afghanistan and Bangladesh and it will be a good one. But, in the meantime, you can switch tabs and catch all the riveting action form the ongoing Pakistan-Afghanistan match. Cheers!

MAN OF THE MATCH, Ravindra Jadeja, says he's very happy to play for the ODI side after a long time. Stresses that he wants to give his best every time he plays and do well for the team. Adds that Kuldeep and Chahal keep the pressure on the batsmen and it allows others to take advantage. Lets everyone know that whenever he used to watch the others in limited-overs cricket, he told himself that he would do whatever it took to get in the side. On whether he's disappointed he didn't get to bat, he says he isn't and will take his chance against Pakistan in the next game.

India skipper, Rohit Sharma, says it was a clinical performance from his side. Mentions that he knew it would be slightly better batting under the lights, which is the reason why he decided to chase. States that it's important to keep rotating the bowlers with shorter spells and not let the batsmen get used to them. Adds that if you keep it tight, the wickets will come. Praises Chahal and Kuldeep despite them not getting wickets, but gives special mention to Jadeja for bowling the way he did, especially after coming into the ODI side after a long time. Emphasizes that he wanted either of him or Dhawan to hang around for a while and even finish the game if possible. Ends by saying that he's looking forward to the next challenge.

Bangladesh skipper, Mashrafe Mortaza, says that it was not a bad wicket to bat on and they could have made 250-260. Adds that they lost their way in the middle overs and couldn't finish off strongly. Mentions that defending 173 is very difficult and he can't be harsh on his bowlers. States that Afghanistan are a tough team to face and they have to be at the top of their game on Sunday. Ends by saying that if they score 250-260, it will give them a good chance.

In response, Rohit and Dhawan got the Men in Blue off to a positive start again. It more or less sealed the deal. Dhawan departed, and Rayudu joined him soon after, but Dhoni hung around and made a 50-run stand with the skipper (who made a solid fifty for himself). MS departed with only a few runs remaining, which Karthik finished after coming in. An emphatic win for the Indians, they'll be quite pleased with their performance tonight. The presentation will be coming up shortly.

The Indian pacers started it off picking early wickets and then, it was Jadeja who stole the show. He bagged 4 on his comeback into the ODI side and ran through the Bangladesh middle order. Kumar and Bumrah got 3 apiece for themselves too. Mehidy Hasan provided a late flurry towards the end and got Bangladesh to 173.

A clinical performance from the Indians. It was kind of expected too, given Bangladesh were relatively fatigued and some key players injured/half-fit. Though, not to take anything away from the Indians, they did a splendid job in all departments. Electing to field after winning the toss, they put the Tigers under immense pressure from the word go.

INDIA WIN BY 7 WICKETS! A victory as comfortable as any. Done in similar fashion too. Karthik adjusts his body and flicks the tossed up delivery through square leg for a single. Handshakes between Karthik and Sharma, nicely done.
Scores are level now as Rohit Sharma drives this down to long off for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan back into the attack.
Full in length on middle stump, blocked safely with bat and pad close together.
Fullish in length and outside off, DK once again walks down the track and drives it this time back to the bowler.
Wide! Seeing Karthik advancing down the track, Mortaza bangs it short and angles it down leg. Dinesh raises his hands and avoids it. Wide called.
Good length delivery on off, worked comfortably past the short mid-wicket fielder by moving inside the line. Single taken.
Dinesh Karthik walks in next.

OUT! Dhoni departs trying to finish things off in style. Length ball outside off, the batsman charges down the track and looks to clear the cover boundary. Doesn't connect as well and it flies down the throat of Mohammad Mithun, who makes no mistake in taking it coming in from the deep. Something to maybe chuckle about for the Tigers.
Connects well again but it's straight to the fielder. Outside off, Dhoni cuts it hard to point. Either side of the fielder and that was game over.
Length delivery outside off, played on the up, connected well, but it's straight to the man at extra cover.
Shortish delivery, on middle and off, turned away in front of square leg easily. One run taken. 4 to win.
The batsman has defended it towards point by getting right behind the line of the delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Sprays it on the pads, worked away on the leg side as the batsmen change ends.
Wide! Short ball over Dhoni's head and it's down the leg side too. It's left alone and the umpire raises his arms sideways to signal a wide.
Guided down to third man with an angled blade. One more run added to the total.
Dhoni's quick and even now, he shows it without any problem. Just pushes this full ball towards mid off and takes the fielder on. Beats the throw at the danger end with ease and completes the run.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, Dhoni stays behind the line and drives it towards the man at mid on.
Slower in pace and fuller in length, outside the line of off stump, pushed gently to mid off to end the over.
Goes down the ground, towards mid on, and a single is taken.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, punched to cover from the back foot again.
Skidding off the surface, ahead of a length, a mistimed punch is played to cover.
Taps it down on the off side and the pair steals another quick run.
Quick single. Good running between the wickets. Dhoni taps this towards mid on and both batsmen take off. Beat the fielder and the subsequent throw eventually.

Meanwhile, we have just got the news that Bangladesh have added Soumya Sarkar and Imrul Kayes to their depleted Asia Cup squad. Well, two games they have to change things - one against Afghanistan on Sunday and then against Pakistan.
Dhoni goes square, places this through point from within the crease and keeps strike.
Punched off the back foot firmly through to sweeper cover for a single.

It's gone behind to the keeper but on the bounce. Seems the extra bounce generated by Mustafizur on this occasion has taken the Indian skipper by surprise. Angling away, on a length, Rohit opens the face and is stuck as the ball rises a bit too much. It goes off the top half of the bat and goes to Rahim on the bounce as he dives to his right to take it.
Outside off again, Rohit throws his bat at this one and misses it completely.
Sharma has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fullish in length and the Fizz keeps it close to off, Rohit Sharma pushes it defensively to covers.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs. India only 15 away from victory here.

Nicely done. Dhoni plays this really late. It's well outside off, so he cuts it down towards third man and comes back for the second. The 50-run stand comes up with this as well. These two are getting the job done comfortably.
Good length delivery in the off stump channel, pushed away to the cover region.

FOUR! BANG! That's gone like a rocket! The power of Dhoni.  It's a short of a length delivery around off, he stands tall and hammers it back down the ground. Almost takes the umpire's head along with that. No chance for anyone to stop it. None.
No ball! Mortaza oversteps and you know what that means - a Free Hit is about to come up. It's a length ball on off, MS clips it in front of square on the leg side.

FOUR! Shot. Strong wrists from MS Dhoni. He waits for the ball to come and then kind of whips his wrists, uses those fast hands and crunches it through the covers. The fielder in the deep attempts to stop it with a dive but is unsuccessful in stopping it.
Mashrafe Mortaza brings himself back on.
Coming back in on middle and off, flicked on the leg side.
Full and going away again outside off, driven by Dhoni to the right of point. The fielder there dives, makes a half-stop and so, the batsmen take a single.
Camps deep inside the crease and pushes the length ball angling away into the off side.
Well connected. The pull shot is played well to deep mid-wicket and the pair takes one run.

Good shot and well fielded too. Short of a good length with some width on offer outside off, Sharma cuts it accurately behind point. Third man moves to his right and cuts it off well, keeping the batsmen to two.
Full on middle and leg, it's wristed back to the bowler.
Angling across on a back of a length, outside off, with an open bat face it's dabbed square to point.
Pushed into the empty space in the covers for a run. Just 32 to win now for India.

FOUR! Landed short and it's punished! Can't be doing that against a class player like Rohit Sharma. He rocks back as he picks up the length early and pulls it powerfully over mid-wicket. One bounce and across the rope for a boundary.
Both are rotating the strike quite well here. Dhoni swivels to this short ball and pulls it behind square leg for a single.
Shaping back in on middle and leg, flicked away neatly through mid-wicket. Easy one taken.
Slightly fuller again, outside off, pushed away tamely on the off side.
Marginally ahead of a length, close to off, Sharma plays a firm punchy drive but finds mid off.
Slanting across from around off, Sharma waits for it, opens the face of the bat and runs it to third man. Will keep strike with a run.
On the shorter side of the length, fraction straight in line, comfortable enough for MS to move inside the line and work it down to fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off stump, flicked in front of square leg. Dot ball this time.
Takes the pace off this one, a length ball on leg, Rohit clips it down to fine leg and crosses over.
Short of a good length on the stumps, Dhoni moves inside the line and tucks it square on the leg side. Easy single taken.
Cutter, on a back of a length on off, Rohit wrists it away towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Mustafizur Rahman is back on.
Too straight again and full as well, clipped nonchalantly to deep mid-wicket for an easy single.
On a length on middle and leg, tucked to the leg side for an easy run.

FOUR! Streaky but effective! Short and there is space to work with. Dhoni frees his arms and throws his bat at it. Ends up getting a thick outside edge towards third man. The fielder there runs to his left and dives full length but fails to stop it.
Similar delivery but this time it is a bit wider outside off. MS hangs back again and punches it towards extra cover this time.
Short of a length around off, Dhoni punches it on the up towards wide mid off.
Crunched but only for a single! Short and room on offer, Rohit slaps it through point. There is a man in the deep who cuts it off.
On the shorter side of things, ample time for Rohit to rock back and ease it away to sweeper cover for a run. He will retain strike.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Shuffles a touch to the loopy delivery and works it around the corner for a single.
On a flatter trajectory, coming in with the arm. Dhoni is hurried a touch as he camps back and punches it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length, Sharma makes use of the depth of the crease and places it through cover-point to rotate strike.
Tossed up on a fullish length outside off, Rohit comes forward and defends it nicely.
Slower one outside off, MS comes forward and eases it towards covers.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
On a length on middle and off, Dhoni helps it away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Hossain bowls a sharp short ball around off, Dhoni sways away from the line and drops his wrists to let it be.
Short of a length and there is a lot of room on offer. Sharma flays it square of the wicket on the off side for a single.
Back of a length ball around off, angling in, pushed off the back foot towards mid on.
Lands around off and then comes slowly off the deck. Sharma is early into the drive and mistimes it towards covers. It lands well short of the fielder though and a run is taken. 11 from the over.
Slows this one and bowls it around off, kept out watchfully.

SIX! Going, going, gone! A half-tracker from Shakib. Sharma lines it up and pulls it over mid-wicket. It is not from the meat of the bat but still has enough to sail over the fence. This is the second long hop he has bowled to Rohit in this innings and he has been put away once more.
Nice way to get off the mark! On the shorter side of things, Dhoni hangs back and tucks it through mid-wicket. Wide vacant spaces there and he easily comes back for the third run.
Stump-to-stump line from Shakib. Dhoni leans ahead and pushes it back to the bowler.
On a flatter trajectory on off, Rohit camps back and punches it to long off for a run.
MS Dhoni comes in at number 4, replacing Rayudu.

OUT! GONE! Good call from Rahim to insist for the review. Back of a length outside off, some room on offer and Rayudu goes for the cut. The ball moves in a bit, and hence goes past the inside edge. Rahim collects and instantly appeals. The umpire remains unmoved but the Bangladesh camp decides to review it after Rahim insistence. It's taken upstairs and replays show that there's a noise as the ball goes past the inside edge. So, Rayudu has to walk back.
Full ball in line of the stumps, defended off the front foot to cover.
Similar length ball outside off, eased away off the back foot through cover-point for a single.
Angling in, clipped off the inner half of the bat through square leg for a run.
A play and a miss! A rare false shot from Sharma! Off cutter outside off, Rohit pushes at it but gets beaten.
Back of a length outside off, Rohit punches it on the up but finds the cover fielder.
Leans ahead and drives this one nicely to long off for a run and Rohit will retain strike.
In line of the stumps, defended back to the bowler.

SIX! That was asking for trouble and it has been dealt with! Rohit brings up his 36th ODI fifty in style! Back-to-back half centuries for him and he is leading from the front. A rank long hop from Shakib, Sharma rocks back and nails the pull way over mid-wicket. Into the stands. He raises his bat and gets a warm round of applause.
Fuller in length on middle and leg, Rohit comes forward and dead-bats it.
On a flatter trajectory, punched off the back foot to cover.
Tossed up on middle and leg, milked down to long on to rotate strike.
A bit of width outside off, glided down to third man for a run.
A good shot! Rohit rocks back to the short one and slaps it to deep point for a single.
Full ball on middle, defended down the track.
Rayudu moves inside the line to the length ball around off and tries to swipe it across. However, he misses and the ball deflects off his thigh pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Fullish ball in line of the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, played with an angled bat towards point.
Tossed up outside off, eased back towards the bowler.

An appeal for an LBW but turned down! Coming in with the arm, Rayudu leans ahead to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads. Shakib appeals but the umpire stays put. Replay confirms that it was bat first before pad.
After landing, this one skids on. Punched off the back foot to long on for a run.
Flighted ball outside off, knocked down to long off to rotate strike.
On a flatter trajectory, kept out from the comfort of the crease.
In the air... but safe! Loopy ball around off, Rayudu tries to chip it over mid off but ends up getting it off the outer half over extra cover. There are vacant spaces there and he gets a double.
FOUR! Drilled! Full ball around off, Rohit clears his front leg and drives it hard through covers to find the fence again.
Slower through the air, swept nicely but straight to square leg.
Tossed up ball, pushed through mid off for a run.
Floated on middle, Sharma closes his bat face early as he tries to flick it across but gets a leading edge towards covers.
FOUR! Shot! Short ball around off, spinning away. Rohit rocks back and cuts it through covers for a delightful boundary.
Quicker one outside off, kept out off the back foot.
Fuller ball on middle and off, Ambati tries to drive it towards long off but gets a thick outside edge towards backward point.
Comes in with the arm, punched off the back foot to the off side.
Quicker one this time, eased off the back foot to mid-wicket.
Well bowled! Coming in with the arm, Ambati keeps his bat and pad close together to keep it out. Shakib puts in a huge appeal for an lbw, but the umpire stays put.
On a flatter trajectory, cut away through point to rotate strike.
Floated around off, Rohit leans ahead and dead-bats it.
Short again and it allows ample time to Rohit to knock it down to long off for a run.
Well fielded! Shorter in length, Rayudu pulls it towards short fine leg. The fielder moves to his left and dives to keep the batsmen only to a single.
Straighter one on middle, pushed off the front foot in front of square leg.
Turning in from around off, defended off the inner half down the track.
Floated outside off, Rayudu leans ahead and dead-bats it.
On middle and leg, helped through square leg for a single.
On middle, turned away through square leg for a run.
Fuller in length, eased back to the bowler.
On a flatter trajectory, kept out of the back foot on the off side.
Tossed up outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
SIX! What a hit! Short ball on middle, Rohit hangs back and pulls it with aplomb over mid-wicket for a massive maximum.
Flatter on middle and leg, whipped towards mid-wicket.
Shorter in length, punched away nicely towards cover.

FOUR! Shot! Tossed up ball, Sharma kneels and sweeps it hard through backward square leg. Shanto in the deep moves to his right and slides and manages to keep the ball in play. But unfortunately, the ball rolls back to the ropes.
Shorter on middle and leg, defended solidly off the back foot.
Full and quick ball around off, blocked off the front foot to the off side.
On the shorter side of things outside off, Ambati hangs back to defend but is beaten by pace.
Loopy ball outside off, driven with an open bat face towards point for a brisk run.
Tossed up outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Stays back and keeps it out safely.
Quicker one outside off, skidding after pitching. Ambati taps it on the leg side for a couple.
Full ball on middle, tucked towards mid on.

OUT! Bangladesh draw first blood! Shakib tosses this one nicely on middle and off and it spins in. Dhawan kneels on one knee and tries to sweep it across but misses it to get pinged on the pads. The bowler and the keeper go up vociferously and the umpire has no hesitation in raising his finger. Shikhar goes across to his skipper and asks whether to take the review or not, to which, he says no. The southpaw has to take the long walk back. Replays show that had he opted for the DRS it wouldn't have made a difference as it was clipping the leg stump.
Tossed up on middle, clipped towards mid-wicket off the front foot.
This one drifts in, Rohit clears his front leg and keeps it out.
Loopy ball around off, Sharma comes ahead and dead-bats it.
This one doesn't spin from outside off. Dhawan carves it away through cover-point to change strike.

A bit uppish but safe! Lands on a fuller length around off and spins in sharply. Rohit clears his front leg and tries to drive it through the line but gets it off the inner half towards mid-wicket. It is well wide of the fielder though and a single is taken.
A bit quicker on middle, played defensively towards square leg.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Quicker through the air outside off, Sharma chops it to the point fielder for a run.
Outside off, dabbed to point for a run.
Short and flat on off, the southpaw looks to muscle the pull through mid-wicket, but mistimes it to the fielder positioned there.
Another single. Rohit once again goes down the ground, towards long on, as he checks his punch.
Quicker and flatter on off, Dhawan moves inside the line and works it through backward square leg for one more.
Tossed up delivery, drifting in on middle and leg, Rohit eases it down to long on for a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
Played to the point region by the batsman.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
The batsman tried to sweep that one but missed it and was hit on the pads. The fielding side are asking the question. The umpire decides the batsman is not out.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
A bit of extra bounce on this one from a length. Dhawan punches it through point
On the shorter side of things again, cut away to sweeper cover for a single.
Similar length ball, punched off the back foot to long on to change strike.
Short ball that skids through after pitching, pulled off the bottom edge of the bat through square leg for a single.
Quick ball down the leg side, swiped away towards the man at 45.

Has that carried? Seems like it went on the bounce from the body language of the Bangladesh fielders. A bit shorter in length on off, spinning in. Dhawan hangs back and tucks it towards mid-wicket but fails to control it properly. The ball flies towards Mehidy Hasan at short mid-wicket. He gets low and seems to have taken it on the bounce. He is not sure whether he has taken it or not and the umpire takes it upstairs. Time for replays. Well, Hasan went for the catch with his fingers pointing downwards and that clearly hit the turf and his fingers simultaneously.
Half-volley outside off, knocked down through wide mid off for a run and Dhawan will retain strike.
No run.
No run.
1 run.
No run.
No run.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
1 run.

FOUR! Not in total control but still effective! Fullish ball outside off, Dhawan drives it through point but while he does so, his bottom hand comes off the bat. The timing is good enough to take the ball to the ropes.
Too straight from Rahman again, helped around the corner for a brace.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Length ball on leg stump, Dhawan moves inside the line and just has to get a tickle on it. He does so and the ball races away to the fine leg fence.
Coming in sharply on a fuller length, Shikhar tries to clip it away but is hit on the pads. A casual appeal ensues but that was always going down leg.
Full ball in line of the stumps, knocked down through mid on for a run. 3 singles from this over.
No pressure at all at the moment. Sharma comes ahead and clips it through mid-wicket to rotate strike.
On middle and leg this time, flicked to the man at square leg.
Full ball on off, placed wide of mid on to rotate strike.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Loopy full ball around off, Shikhar lunges and keeps it out.

FOUR! Mustafizur is not successful in bowling a maiden! That was straight as an arrow. Overpitched ball on middle. Sharma with a high backlift lifts it over the bowler's head and away she goes. Delightful to watch.
Five dots in a row! Mustafizur drags his length back and delivers this one outside off. Sharma stands tall and punches it with the angle to the cover fielder. Can Rahman bowl a maiden?
Good length ball on the hips of Sharma. He makes good use of the depth of the crease and helps it towards mid-wicket.
Fractionally overpitched just outside off, Sharma strides ahead and plays a punchy drive to mid off.
Pitched slightly ahead this time, pushed off the front foot to the off side.
Length ball on off, pitches and then seams away with the natural angle. Rohit goes to the pitch of the ball and taps it with an open bat face towards cover-point.
Too easy at the moment for India! Dhawan works the straighter one through mid-wicket. There are vacant spaces there and he comes back for the second run easily.
A half-volley outside off, driven crisply towards wide mid off to rotate strike.
Slower through the air, outside off, the right-hander takes a step forward and smothers the turn.
Rohit waits for the tossed up ball to arrive and helps it with the spin towards square leg.
Floated on a fullish length outside off, defended solidly off the front foot.
Slower through the air around off, Sharma comes forward and dead-bats it.
Dhawan needs to be patient, shouldn't get carried away. Short of a length outside off, angling in. Dhawan goes for the big pull but misses.
Fuller length ball on middle, tucked with a closed bat face to the leg side.

SIX! Clean as a whistle! Short ball attacking the body of Dhawan. It comes to him at a good height though. He stands tall and with his one leg up in the air, flamingo style, pulls it in front of square leg for a maximum. Ominous signs for the opposition.
On a good length, on middle and leg, Dhawan hops a touch and defends it besides the pitch on the leg side.
This time he finds the gap! Identical delivery to the last one, Rohit places it past the point fielder to change strike.
Starts off with a fuller length ball, leaving the right-hander. He plants his front foot across and plays it with an angled bat to the point fielder.
Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack.
0.5: M Mortaza to R Sharma,
On a shorter length, spinning in slowly. Sharma makes use of the depth of the crease and helps it in front of square leg for a run and will retain strike.
Floated generously around off, Shikhar clears his front leg and eases it through covers to rotate strike.
Nicely done! Slower through the air on a fullish length outside off, Dhawan drives it crisply past the extra cover fielder. Mortaza chases it and keeps the batsmen down to a couple.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Spinning into Rohit who clips it to mid-wicket.
Tossed up outside off, Sharma comes forward and defends it nicely towards point. Wants a run but there is none on offer.

That one stopped a bit on the track. Mortaza pulls his length back a touch. Dhawan pushes at it. Gets it past the short cover fielder but is intercepted by the man behind him. 8 from this one, a good one for India.
Angling into the batsman on a fullish length, the southpaw shuffles a touch and works it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! This one is majestic! He is batting with a lot of authority. Shikhar walks down the track and drills the overpitched delivery through covers to find the fence.
FOUR! Width offered and duly accepted! Full ball wide outside off, Dhawan throws his bat at it and flays it over point to get his first boundary.
Pitched up this time, just outside off. Dhawan leans ahead and defends it solidly.
Mortaza steams in from around the wicket and bowls a length ball around off, Dhawan hangs back and stonewalls it.
Too straight from Hasan, Dhawan helps it around the corner for a run. A tidy start from Mehidy.
Fuller in length on middle and off, Sharma drives it through mid on to rotate strike
Continues to loop it up around the eye-line of the batsman as the southpaw prods forward and tucks it with a closed bat face through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy delivery around off, Shikhar gets to the pitch of the ball and plays it with soft hands towards point.
Spinning away from around off, punched away on the off side for nothing.
Tossed up outside off, eased to the off side off the front foot.
Driven towards the mid off region.
